articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Withholds Executable, Sets $15M Token Market Cap Threshold
articles.description: According to ChainCatcher citing PC Gamer and CoinGecko, a leaker who identifies as Cyberleek distributed a torrent of what they claim is a near-complete 209 GB Xbox version of GTA 6 from November 2026, but withheld the game’s main executable. Modders would need the file to simulate the game on PC…

articles.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
articles.description: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
